page: Microsoft Azure NG32adms_V620_v1 is a virtualized server instance belonging to the NGADSV620v1 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD x86_64 processor. It is equipped with 176.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 5.5 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration integrates a single AMD V620 GPU with 30 GB of dedicated VRAM, providing hardware acceleration for graphics and compute workloads. Local storage is bundled with the instance, consisting of a 4889 GB NVMe SSD, which delivers high-capacity, low-latency local data access. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the combination of dedicated AMD CPU cores, a high-capacity NVMe SSD, and a 30 GB VRAM GPU positions this instance as a specialized option for memory-intensive and GPU-accelerated tasks. The hardware profile is optimized for workloads such as database hosting, remote visualization, memory-heavy data processing, and GPU-assisted rendering where local high-speed storage is required.
